content: Fuwain edde baf mar uwore hokum
Fuwain okkol, tũwara Malike ze bafe sar he bafe baf mare mano kiyollahoile hiyan gora soiyi.
"Tũwar baf mare šorman goro," Iyan ei foila hokum ziyanor fũwati wada ase.
"Zene tũwar balai o, edde ei duniyait tũwar haiyat bare."
Baf okkol, tũwara nizor nizor fuwain okkolore gušša tuli no diyo, bolke Malikor šikka edde nosiyot di hitarare manuš gori tulo.
Gulam edde malikolla šikka
Gulam okkol, tũwara zendilla Mosire mano hendilla ḍor edde ijjot loi dilor butottu tũwara ei duniyair malik okkolore mano.
Hitarar mon faibolla hoi tũwarar šude malik okkolor sukor sarme no maniyo, bolke hiyanottuwaro Mosir gulam hisabe zane dile Allar issaye falon goro.
Tũwara manušor gulami hisabe no, bolke Malikolla hoi razi mone ham goro.
Edde zani rako ze, fotti kiye ze bala ham gore, hite gulam ok ba azadi ok, Malikor hãsottu hiyanor fól faibo.
Ar malik okkol, tũwara o hitara loi hindilla bebohar goro. Hitarare ḍor noiddo, kiyollahoile tũwara zano ze hitara edde tũwarar Malik, ze behostot ase, ar hibaye hono kiyore beš hom no gore.
Allar larair hãz fušak
Šeše hoir, tũwara Malikot edde hibar kudurutir šoktit mojbut o.
Allar hár larair hãz fušak findo, zene Šoitanor hár ḍoilla salaki loi mukabela gori faro.
Ãrar ei larai hono manušor loi no, kintu hin andaijja raijjor hár šašongoroya edde kemotawala okkol loi, asmanor hár horaf šoinno okkol loi.
Etolla tũwara Allar hár hãz fušak lo, zene ze din Šoitane hamela goribo he din tũwara hitare ruki tiyagarai faro edde hár kissu hotom gorifelai tiyai tai faro.
Etolla soiyi di kiyail bando, forhesgari di sina guro,
edde šantir kušir hóboror zuta findi tiyar tako.
In bade biššašor ḍal tolowar lo, ziyanor duwara tũwara he Šoitanor hár zolonto tir nifaifelai fariba.
Edde matat uddaror helmeṭ edde Pak Ruhor toluwar lo, zin Allar kalam.
Pak ruhur duwara hamiša munazat edde foriyad goro. Etolla furafuri seton tako edde hár paki manuš okkololla foriyador fũwati munazat gorat tako.
Ãlla o munazat goijjo zene ãi zẽtte muk kuli hẽtte Allaye ãre en zuban zuhai de, zene ãi ḍor sara he kušir hóboror gufon soyire tobolig gori fari.
Ziyanolla buli ãi siyolor ban hái bade o ekzon Mosir hóbor faṭoya hisabe ham gorir. Munazat goro zene ãi ḍor sara ze bafe gora fore he bafe elan gori fari.
Šeš hota edde duwa
Ãrar adoijja bái Tykikous, ze ekzon Malikor soiyi biššaši gulam, hibaye tũwarare hár hota hoibo, toi zene tũwara zani faro ãi ken asi, ãr din ki, hondilla zar.
Tũwara zene ãrar babute zani faro, edde tũwarar dilot tuwajjo di fare, hiyanolla ãi hibare tũwarar hãse defeṛair.
Baf Allah edde Malik Isa Mosittu šanti edde biššašor fũwati muhabbot báiyaindor uwore ok.
Ãrar Malik Isa Mosire zara ošeš muhabbot gore, hitara beggunor uwore rahamot takok.
